sum_insured_options: Not specified in wording (₹1Cr, ₹2Cr, ₹3Cr options referenced for room upgrade)

room_rent.note: No cap if occupancy is Single Private A/C Room or lower. Proportionate deduction applies if higher room chosen. Optional 'Any Room Upgrade' available for SI of ₹1Cr, ₹2Cr, ₹3Cr.

icu.note: ICU charges covered under Section 3.1 with no separate sub-limit mentioned in the wording.

copayment.note: No mandatory co-payment mentioned in the policy wording.

sub_limits.display: Maternity capped at ₹30,000; Newborn ₹10,000; Air Ambulance ₹5L; OPD ₹5,000/₹10,000
sub_limits.note: Maternity sub-limit ₹30,000 (optional cover); Newborn Baby ₹10,000; Air Ambulance ₹5L; OPD benefit ₹5,000 individual/₹10,000 floater. Core hospitalisation has no disease-wise sub-limits.

deductible.note: No aggregate deductible mentioned in the policy wording.

initial_waiting.note: Standard 30-day waiting period for illnesses; not applicable for accidents.

ped_waiting.note: PED waiting period as per policy schedule; standard IRDAI portability credit applies.

specific_disease_waiting.note: Specific disease/procedure waiting period as per Section 4.1.2; exact months subject to Policy Schedule but standard is 24 months.

maternity.note: Covered under Section 3.13 as optional cover; limit ₹30,000 for delivery/termination (max 2 events lifetime); 36-month continuous coverage wait; Newborn Baby benefit ₹10,000 additional.

cumulative_bonus.note: Guaranteed Bonus accrues each year regardless of claims; exact percentage and maximum cap specified in Policy Schedule, not stated in wording. This is an optional cover (Section 3.10).

restoration.note: Section 3.12: Automatic restoration of Base Sum Insured up to 100% for number of times as per Policy Schedule. Restoration for same ailment only for subsequent distinct claims (not within 45-day Any One Illness window). Number of restorations per year per Policy Schedule.

pre_hosp.note: Pre-hospitalisation expenses covered under Section 3.2; exact number of days not stated in wording, referenced to Policy Schedule.

post_hosp.note: Post-hospitalisation expenses covered under Section 3.3; exact number of days not stated in wording, referenced to Policy Schedule.

day_care.note: Section 3.1 covers Day Care Treatment for all eligible procedures under general or local anaesthesia.

domiciliary.note: Section 3.7: Domiciliary Hospitalisation is an optional cover; requires Medical Practitioner certification; minimum 3 consecutive days.

ayush.note: Section 3.6: AYUSH inpatient treatment is an optional cover; reduces Sum Insured; pre/post-hospitalisation also covered.

organ_donor.note: Section 3.8: Organ Donor harvesting expenses covered as optional cover; reduces Sum Insured.

ambulance.note: Section 3.4: Emergency road ambulance covered at actuals (no fixed cap stated). Section 3.16: Air Ambulance up to ₹5L as optional cover.

modern_treatments.note: Section 3.1 explicitly covers Modern Treatments (robotic surgery, oral chemo, stereotactic, etc.) under inpatient hospitalisation with no separate sub-limit stated.

consumables.note: Section 3.14: Non-payable/consumable items (List I of Annexure I) covered as optional add-on; reduces Sum Insured.

global_cover.note: Section 5.2.7 and 4.2.10 explicitly restrict coverage to India only.

moratorium.note: Section 5.1.14: After 5 continuous years no look-back applies; claims not contestable except for proven fraud.

grace_period.note: Section 5.1.9: 30-day grace period for annual renewal. Monthly instalment grace is 15 days.

free_look.note: Section 5.1.11: 30-day free-look period for new policies only; not applicable on renewals or porting.

portability.note: Section 5.1.8: Portability allowed as per IRDAI guidelines.

notable_exclusions.display: External congenital anomaly, OPD (unless add-on), war/nuclear/bio/chemical, self-inflicted injury, treatment outside India, sterility/infertility

optional_riders.display: AYUSH, Domiciliary, Organ Donor, Maternity+Newborn, Non-payable items, Air Ambulance, Guaranteed Bonus, OPD benefit, Accidental Death, Room Upgrade, Restoration
